name: claude-studio-mods
description: Small, tested Claude Code mods: a secrets guard, a changed-files tracker, and an Obsidian Kanban status line

plugins.name: secret-guard
plugins.description: Stops Claude from reading or editing .env files, private keys and credential files

plugins.name: touched-files
plugins.description: A running list of every file Claude changed this session

plugins.name: kanban-status
plugins.description: Your Obsidian Kanban board in the status line, with a /board pane
